title: What The Drums Know — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal music philosophy Spanish French language learning rhythm
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The drums are the oldest instrument — they predate the word
They were present at the first decision and the first thing heard
By anything on the planet that could register a beat
The drums were there before the song and they'll be there after it's complete

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
Los tambores son el instrumento más antiguo — antes de la palabra
[The drums are the oldest instrument — before the word]
Estaban presentes en la primera decisión — su sombra
[They were present at the first decision — their shadow]
El ritmo es el primer lenguaje del mundo
[Rhythm is the first language of the world]
Los tambores saben el secreto más profundo
[The drums know the deepest secret]

[Chorus — English]
What do the drums know that I don't know?
They know the heartbeat is the original metronome below
What do the drums know when the groove locks in?
They know that everything else is decoration — and the beat is what was been
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Les tambours sont les plus anciens instruments — avant la parole
[The drums are the oldest instruments — before speech]
Ils étaient présents à la première décision — leur rôle
[They were present at the first decision — their role]
Le rythme est le premier langage du monde entier
[Rhythm is the first language of the whole world]
Les tambours savent ce que le cœur veut exprimer
[The drums know what the heart wants to express]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the drums know… Lo que saben los tambores… Ce que savent les tambours
The heartbeat was first — El corazón fue primero — Le cœur a été premier
That's my boy
